documents.title: POL-U2100.02 Ensuring Academic Honesty
documents.summary: The university academic-honesty policy for all students lists unauthorized use of generative AI as a violation and says some instructors prohibit AI while others allow it with citation. It leaves the AI rule to the syllabus and sets general sanctions, a standard of proof and an appeals process.
documents.stance_why: The policy names 'the unauthorized use of computer-generated text (generative AI)' as a violation but sets no AI rule of its own. It says 'Some instructors may prohibit any use of digital resources such as generative AI whereas other instructors may allow it when properly cited', handing the decision to instructors, so delegates.
